Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 36 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Naira - 9 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Siya - 11 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Night

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi, Naira and Siya stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "It's very late tonight."

[A full moon shines in the sky.]

Siya: "Careful!"

[Fireflies glow in the dark.]

Meenakshi: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Naira stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "So, here we are!"

[Ayaan writes in his notebook.]

Naira: "This is amazing!"

[Ayaan does his homework at the table.]

Naira: "Aunty, listen!"

[Ayaan lies down on the sofa.]

Meenakshi: "Good job, Ayaan!"

[Ayaan slams the door shut.]

Naira: "I really enjoyed today."
